newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Zeitler sees no change in rate trend.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Zeitler sees no change in rate trend.

text.p: Germany is not on the verge of a change in the interest rate cycle and the price climate should remain calm in 1997, Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph Zeitler said on Friday.
Zeitler said he did not expect another decline in the inflation rate, but considered the central bank's forecast of inflation of between 1.5 percent and two percent to be realistic.
"The beast inflation is never completely dead," Zeitler said.
Zeitler said he was in favour of the Bundesbank continuing to orient its monetary policy toward the development of M3 money supply growth, which had been easing recently.
